title: Scope restored panes to their project and persist the conductor
done_when: Pane rosters and conductor identity are stored and loaded per project, keyed by the project the window persists to; a successful restart reopens the same pane ids, brains, isolation flags, saved worktrees and conductor as fresh processes; a missing conductor pane clears the role with a visible explanation; switching projects never restores or overwrites another project's panes, and a window that switches mid-session stops persisting and says so until it is restarted, except that an empty window that opened with no project may bind to the first project picked when that destination is provably unused; the pre-scoping roster and conductor are adopted together by exactly one project and never split or inherited by a second; dirty or unusable worktrees are preserved and reported; and tests cover restart, project switching, corrupt saved state, failed pane spawn and conductor restore failure (BACKLOG.md, 'Restoring panes does not restore the agents that occupied them').
